batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b M Morkel

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Iqbal Abdulla b R Bhatia

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b KW Richardson

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b PV Tambe

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b JP Faulkner

balls.text: reaches for a full and wide one and it goes to third man, Faulkner pushes for the second and makes it
moves outside off once more, but Vinay goes short now, and Smith is hurried into his pull, the ball rolls away on off
Smith does it, he walks outside off, this is a wide and low full toss, and Smith flicks it behind square leg
Rahane sensed this would be full and wide again, he moves outside off but Vinay goes wider and Rahane's only dragged it tamely to long on
gets the yorker in outside off once more, Smith can only dig it out
wide one in the blockhole, Rahane reaches out and squeezes it in front of square
straighter one forced down to long off
leaves the crease again, and drives to cover
stays in the crease and slogs but cannot get hold of it
jumps out, Narine slows it down and shortens the length, Smith adjusts to work it in front of square and races back for two more
moves to the leg side and swings at this full delivery, it takes the outside edge and races fine past the keeper on off
walks out first ball to Narine and flicks it square off the pad
a low full toss, Smith cranks up and whips it in the air over midwicket but he has not timed it
drags this short one from wide outside off through midwicket
in the blockhole wide outside off, Smith toe ends it through point
pitched up delivery whipped through midwicket
Binny goes first ball, backs away a bit, Morkel goes short of a length and widish outside off, Binny stretches to have a go at the cut, but nicks it behind
a high full toss, Rahane was moving out and towards the leg side, slaps it to mid off
shorter one at 104 kph, comes too quickly onto him for any timing on the pull, it is dragged to deep midwicket
driven off the front foot to the left of sweeper cover for two more
tries the reverse sweep but is beaten by this offbreak
quick down the pads, swept to short fine leg, who cannot stop it cleanly
leading edge to point this time as he tries to turn it to leg
well done, Rahane comes out, moves inside the line of this offbreak and drills it square on the off side

what a gifted wicket, full toss outside off, Watson pummels it through the covers, throw comes in from the sweeper, two bounces to the keeper, Watson is not really charging back, he realises he needs to dive, but he's fallen short by inches, Pandey's been sharp in the field tonight
pitched up outside off, pushed in the air down to long off
low and wide full toss steered wide of the sweeper

tries to slam this over deep midwicket, but mishits it, Shakib comes in too much though, and by  the time he corrects himself, it has become too high for him although he gets an outstretched hand to it
tries to hit this short of a length ball on the up, but is beaten by slight away movement and the carry
starts with a widish short of a length ball, and Rahane goes to fifty by punching it to the right of the sweeper
this one will go, Watson brings up 2000 runs for Royals by powering this flat delivery over extra cover, sat up that one
rocks back but this is 101 kph on the stumps and he stabs it back
skips out and tries to go over extra cover again, but ends up chipping it to the sweeper
offbreak comes in from a length, Watson cannot get hold of the pull, takes the single to deep square
punches a straightish length ball down the track
straighter one just outside off, Rahane guides it to point for a single
almost got him there, this was shorter but hurried on towards the stumps, Watson had set himself up for the pull, and an inside edge saves him as it races past the keeper
overpitched at 88.7 kph outside off, Watson gets forward and drills it powerfully through extra cover
this is flat-batted hard past the bowler, but long off will get to it
Watson picks this full delivery from outside off and slog-sweeps it over midwicket, beats long on easily
driven off the front foot to the sweeper
jumps out to a 79 kph delivery, but manages only a thick inside edge, wasn't quite to the pitch
a full toss but he pushes it softly straight to sweeper cover
pushes off the front foot through extra cover, Rahane wants the second, but Pandey runs in and lets go of it quickly, and Rahane has to turn back
darts it in quick and full, Watson cannot work it away
hurls it very full and very wide, but just inside the marker, well bowled
angled in to the pad, he leans forward and nudges it to short fine leg
flatter on a length, Watson has time to cut it hard, but the sweeper gets to it with a slide
tossed up and bowled slower at 79 kph, Rahane pushes it towards cover
fuller delivery, Watson uses the inward angle to nudge it square on the leg side
stretches forward and defends this length ball to cover
tossed up just outside off at 92 kph, defended
Rahane goes in his favoured zone, comes down the track and lofts cleanly over extra cover, safely out of the reach of the sweeper
bowls it full and wide, Watson reaches it and slaps it to the sweeper
defended to leg off the front foot
skips out, reaches the pitch of the ball and slams it straight over the bowler
Watson is tentative initially but then he presses forward and defends this length ball to leg
angled in full on off, driven to long off
angled in quicker towards off, he turns it towards vacant mid on for a single, bowler fields
nudged off the front foot to the leg side
googly spins in and hits Rahane on the pad, he is caught on the crease but that is headed down leg
Chawla corrects the line, tosses it up, pitches it on a good length around off, Rahane defends
flighted full again, but pitches down the leg side, and Rahane sweeps it hard and fine
tossed up full outside off, he moves forward and pushes it square for a single
length ball slanted in to the pad, turned square
angled in and tossed up full, worked to long on
full delivery pushed down to long off
he goes back to a full delivery and pays for it, Samson tries to make room outside leg, but the ball does not turn, it carries onto hit him low on the pad and rolls onto the stumps
driven to point
skips out but converts this tossed up ball into a yorker, digs it back, but Shakib cannot stop it
angles it away from the right-hander and wide outside off, he tries to reach it but misses
slower length ball at 110 kph outside off, guided to third man
length ball swinging into the pad, Rahane tucks it through square leg and comes back easily for the second
leans forward and defends a slower delivery pitched up around off
there have been a few of these tonight, another one darts in from just back of a length and rolls square on the off side
starts with a pitched up, widish delivery that is played out to point
a thick inside edge rolls to vacant mid on as Rahane looks to push on the off side, bowler is after it, but they do well to take the second
angled in from wide of the crease, straightens just outside off, cut straight to point
defended down the track off the front foot
tossed up high and full around off, pushed down to long on
slides in with the angle first ball, Rahane escapes as he manages an inside edge onto pad
fourth boundary of the over, Samson is in control of this one, Morkel overpitches on the stumps, Samson clips it to the deep midwicket rope
he's got away with this, drags this bouncer half-heartedly from outside off, and the top edge flies over short fine
Samson has another swing, but this darts in a long way from just outside off, and hits him on the thigh pad
this is good length pitching on middle, angling in to the pad, and Samson's reacted quickly to flick it fine
a full and wide outswinger at 146 kph, Samson reaches for it, misses
Morkel pitches it up, Samson takes it on and cracks it down the ground
stays in the crease to one rising from a length, and guides it to third man
good length offbreak at 95 kph comes in from outside off, pushed away
tossed up offbreak turning into the pad, nudged behind square
guides a fuller one outside off to point
makes some room outside leg, Narine bowls a straighter one on off, Samson slaps it down to long on
straightish good length ball outside off, he carefully pushes it back
Narine produces a leading edge first ball as Samson comes forward to a pitched up ball, it rolls to extra cover
has a go at the cut again, but this back of a length ball does not get up as much as he anticipates and goes under his swish
nips in from short of a length, and hits him high on the pad
shot, he leans back as Morkel gives him width outside off and cracks the cut neatly behind backward point, third man has no chance
length ball defended off the front foot to the off side
between wide slip and the keeper, Rahane flashes at a rising short of a length ball, but Kallis is too wide to have much chance with this one

run out chance, but the throw misses at the non-striker's end even as Samson dives in, it would have been in vain had Pandey hit, Rahane had defended this short of a length ball close to the pitch on off and had sent Samson back after he rushed halfway up the track
much fuller and angled in, Rahane works it along the ground to deep square
a leading edge, but out of the reach of backward point and flies to third man, he was trying to turn this short of a length ball to leg
just back of a length, on the stumps, he plays it quietly down the track
comes forward to defend a length ball to cover
climbs high from short of a length and also moves away, left alone
Nair charges out to a good length delivery, it comes in a bit after pitching and goes past his heave to hit the top of the stumps
a fuller delivery pushed softly to extra cover
good length delivery slanted in a tad to off, Rahane comes across and nudges it square on the leg side
tries his preferred back of a length now, and it climbs steeply, but well down leg
Morkel persists with the fuller length, Rahane comes forward and pushes it towards mid on
another one coming in from a pitched up length outside off, a thick inside edge rolls to leg as he pushes carefully
this nipped in from outside off, there is an appeal for lbw, but there was an inside edge there
slants it in again, on a good length this time, and it carries down the leg side
starts full on the stumps, and is tucked in front of square, Shakib chases it and pulls it back near the rope
pushed square on the off side
Nair beaten by his Karnataka team-mate first ball, plays outside the line of this back of a length ball, which does not carry to the keeper
back of a length, angled in to the right hander, nudged square to leg
back of a length, outside off, left alone
overpitched around off, and Rahane uses the bit of inward angle to clip it through midwicket, excellent timing
short and wide to start with, Rahane does not go too hard at it, slaps it away square, where cover dives to prevent the boundary
scores are tied, Shakib drags this full delivery down the ground, long off rushes in but his throw is not strong enough to prevent the second, and we go into a Super Over
Shakib comes out and lofts wide of long off for a couple
not called a wide, Shakib went towards off to try and scoop it to fine leg, missed as it was slanted past leg stump
full on off, Narine tries to drive it through the covers, cannot get the mistimed stroke past the infield
he sends it way down the leg side from wide of the crease

a run-out now, Shakib backs away and forces a full delivery to long on, Chawla wants the second, Shakib does not and raises his hand, but Chawla is too far out already and is run out by miles as Smith fires it to the keeper
Shakib gets four first ball, he arches back to a high full toss and smears it through the covers, there is no sweeper
Faulkner just misses the hat trick, slow delivery bounces from a length, past Chawla's swipe, and goes over the stumps
Faulkner keeps hitting the stumps, another slower one, full on off stump this time, Vinay swings and misses
Uthappa's gone too far across, Faulkner bowls the slower one from back of the hand, good length on middle and leg, Uthappa misses, and Faulkner hits
Faulkner goes full into leg stump at 140 kph, Shakib gets a thick inside edge to fine leg
backs away to the leg side, Faulkner tries to follow him but sends it further down instead
another skier, this was down the leg side, and Shakib swung hard at it, but this time, it falls short of deep square leg running to his left
Faulkner's kept this alive, Yadav's skied this full and wide one slanted across him, and Smith has run in from long off and taken it in front of his head
tries to go square on the leg side from outside off, edges it into the helmet and it pops up close by
attacks a similar delivery and hits it to deep midwicket this time
swings at a pitched up delivery angled in but cannot get it away
another one, he goes deep in the crease to a full delivery and whips it through midwicket, timed well enough to beat long on
fine leg is up, Shakib pulls a shortish ball, and it runs past the fielder's dive, deep square chases and dives too, in vain
full and wide one driven to sweeper cover
a low full toss driven to long off
that'll help too, Watson is full and wide again, Yadav swings, the thick edge flies past the keeper
Yadav's doing it for KKR, he's stretched forward and across, taken this full delivery from outside off, and swept it over deep square leg
Shakib comes out, Watson goes full across him, he stabs it to the off side
walks outside off, Watson foes full in that region, he squeezes it square
goes full and wide, batsman misses, but umpire Dar stretches his left hand, because Watson has bowled a massive no ball
he's taken this low full toss from outside off, and in trying to lift it to fine leg, has smacked it straight into his helmet
steps out and forces it to deep midwicket, there is a direct hit at the striker's end and they take one more for the ricochet
Shakib slog-sweeps off his pad to deep square leg now
another sweep, picks it from outside off, hits it to deep backward square
this is angled down the pads, Yadav bends on his knee and sweeps it high over short fine leg
swept to short fine leg
swept from outside off behind square leg
steps out, takes it on the full and works it to deep midwicket
appeal for leg before turned down as he misses a sweep, pitched just outside leg
flatter one pushed down to long off
moves inside the line and lofts cleanly over extra cover
flat length ball forced wide of deep midwicket for two more
charges out and has a heave, on a couple of bounces to long on as he moves to his left, almost overran it
guides a length ball through point and wide enough of the sweeper to take two
Bhatia's struck, Gambhir's swept a cutter off his pads high and straight to deep square leg
still slower length ball slapped past extra cover
drives a length delivery to extra cover
floats this well down the leg side
length ball turned to deep midwicket
plumb, Tambe comes back by slipping in the quicker one, Pandey is caught clueless and he is right in front
flatter and quicker, Pandey takes it from outside off and pulls it to the deep midwicket rope
Pandey gets one away, he charges out, takes it on the full and hammers it over deep midwicket
another shout for lbw as Gambhir misses another paddle against Tambe, this one pitched just outside leg
makes some room and cuts, but finds point, Pandey was a long way out and had to rush  back
drives but cannot time it, gets it past extra cover though
angled in, helped along to short fine leg, Gambhir rushes across for the single and makes it in time
Tambe's done well, this was swung hard and flat and was bouncing just in front of him, he went back a little at deep square leg, and stopped it from going past
this was down the leg side, and Gambhir went across to try and sweep it past short fine leg, but found the man
attacks this over pitched ball and drills it wide of long on
tries to whack it over midwicket but there is no pace to lift it, he mistimes it down to long on
moves across, Bhatia bowls it around off at 95 kph, Gambhir adjusts to dab it behind point
works a full one down to long on
turns a flighted ball with the spin through midwicket and comes back for the second
full delivery hit down to long on
pushed down the leg side at 87 kph, Pandey misses as he tries to whip it fine
down the track and whips it to deep midwicket
shout for lbw as Gambhir misses the paddle, that is an excellent shout, pitched in line and hit him in front of middle and leg
was looking to paddle it initially, but saw it slanted across outside off, tried to dab it but missed
a slow length ball at just 90 kph moving away outside off, Pandey works it through midwicket
pushed to extra cover
close to off stump, he waits and dabs to third man
right in the gap between sweeper cover and long off, Gambhir steps forward to a fuller one cutting across him and lifts it over extra cover
108 kph good length ball turned to deep midwicket
opens up and forces this length delivery to long on
waits on this tossed up ball outside off and dabs it to short third man
Smith runs in from long off and takes this skier, after Kallis top-edges a slog-sweep to this tossed up full delivery just outside off
straightens outside off, he guides it to sweeper cover
flat and angled into the pad, worked fine
drives a very full one to sweeper cover
moves back and cuts a flat delivery to sweeper cover
sends this one into the pad, and Kallis happily nudges it fine past the keeper
cuts this short and wide one hard but not far enough from sweeper cover
sharp, accurate bouncer at 136 kph, Gambhir tries to hook but is beaten
moves down the track and pushes to long off
leaves the crease but only gets an inside edge through square leg
another sound as Watson moves this away wide outside off, Kallis plays at it and misses, the sound comes after ball passes bat though
this is a slower one angled across him at 91 kph, Gambhir is beaten, keeper appeals for stumping, but Gambhir's foot was back in time
Gambhir lofts this nicely over extra cover, long off runs around
goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover
tries to hit this slow length ball outside off, but is beaten by the lack of pace
picks this from outside off and sweeps it over square leg, falls just short of Faulkner running across
good length ball guided to point
back of a length and straightening on the pad, Gambhir cannot work it away
runs this pitched up delivery to slip on the bounce
punches a good length delivery to point
Kallis swings hard at the free hit, and it flies down to third man

Watson has struck big in his first over, there is a clear noise as Kallis tries to force this incoming length ball outside off, Samson hangs on, and the umpire raises his finger, but hold on, Watson has overstepped
steps out and whips it off the pad, on a couple of bounces to deep midwicket
full and slanted across the left-hander, he mishits the drive to short extra cover
straightish and pitched up around off, pushed back
knocks a full delivery on the stumps to long on
this is full on the pad at 92 kph and Gambhir's sweep only needs to beat square leg, which it does
makes room to a flat delivery and punches it past extra cover
Kallis moves out as well, gets a thick inside edge to short fine
comes out and whips it off the pad to deep square leg
comes outside the crease but is beaten outside off
pitched up and moving in towards off, Kallis defends from the crease
bowls it on a good length wide outside off, it comes in a bit, Bisla attacks it, but can only thick edge to slip, who moves to his left to take a head-high catch
sees Bisla charging out and digs it short, that comes back in alarmingly, and almost hits him, Bisla backs down just in time
moving away from the left-hander who runs it to third man
appeal for lbw, Gambhir hit on the pad on the forward press with a good length outswinger but that pitched outside leg
hit on the pad with a length ball but that was going down leg
guides a length ball to backward point
Gambhir smacks a pull off the front foot just in front of square leg for a one-bounce four, that is well executed, the short ball was angled in and climbing on him
works a good length ball off the pad to square leg
moving away wide from the left-hander, Gambhir tries a cut and misses
short and wide, and Bisla cuts, just past a diving backward point
slants it down the leg side first up, and Samson's dive does not convert into a clean stop
that zips past the outside edge, he was playing for inward movement after those last two balls but this does not come back in as much
similar delivery, slightly tighter line, pushed back from the crease
moves in from back of a length, is pushed off the back foot
dabbed down to third man
Gambhir hits his first four of the season, this is a similar delivery, moving across and rising outside off, but he waits and places it between cover and point
that is short of a length and zooms past Gambhir's attempted cut, away swing and bounce
pitched up outside off, he leans forward to defend to extra cover
pulls a short ball, hasn't timed it but it is safely hit in the air in front of square
a leading edge loops over cover as Binny swings it away late, Bisla was playing the angle and trying to clip it to leg
this comes in to Gambhir from short of a length, he hops and runs it to third man again
straightens from a length wide outside off, is punched to sweeper cover
short of a length, Gambhir gets on his toes and dabs it to third man to get off the mark
